## Is Razorpay good value when you compare payment gateway charges in India?


The cheapest payment gateway for your business is the one with the lowest total cost for the payment methods and tools you actually need. Compare the transaction rate, fixed charges, taxes and optional services using the same sales volume and payment mix.


Razorpay is a strong choice when you want a clearly published standard rate, no setup fee or annual maintenance charge, and routes to collect payments through a website or a shared link. Its[standard domestic platform fee is 2% plus applicable GST](https://razorpay.com/pricing/) ; custom pricing and introductory offers have their own terms.


Choose Razorpay when those capabilities fit your workflow and the full cost works for your business. Use the calculation below to make that decision with your own numbers.


### What are you paying for?

Zero MDR on standard bank-to-bank UPI does not make Razorpay’s gateway service free: its[pricing page distinguishes bank MDR from the platform fee](https://razorpay.com/pricing/) . Quote optional products, special payment methods and settlement services separately.


### What if access to funds matters more than the lowest fee?


If your business needs funds sooner for stock or operations, compare settlement options alongside transaction fees. Razorpay documents[Instant Settlements](https://razorpay.com/docs/payments/settlements/) as an on-demand feature that can provide access sooner than the standard settlement cycle. Request activation and confirm availability, limits and charges for your account before including it in your cost model.


This gives you another way to evaluate Razorpay: select the settlement arrangement that fits your cash-flow needs, and measure whether its benefit justifies any additional cost. Do not treat faster settlement as a free feature of every standard account.


## What Goes Into Payment Gateway Charges: The 7 Costs That Decide the Cheapest Option


Use your actual quote for each component: platform fee by payment method, applicable GST, setup fee, annual maintenance charge, optional settlement service, refund/chargeback treatment and recurring-payment product charges. Razorpay’s standard plan has no setup fee or AMC. Confirm[current pricing](https://razorpay.com/pricing/) and account-specific terms instead of assuming a competing provider has fixed fees.


Standard bank-to-bank UPI has zero bank MDR, while Razorpay charges a separate standard platform fee of 2% plus applicable GST unless your approved offer or contract specifies otherwise. Use the[current pricing page](https://razorpay.com/pricing/) and your contracted rates when budgeting.


## Compare promotional offers using their actual terms


If you qualify for an introductory offer, check the duration, cumulative volume limit, eligible payment methods and exclusions in the current approved terms. Calculate the cost after the offer ends as well. Do not assume all methods or additional products are free or enabled from day one.


Use the[Razorpay pricing page](https://razorpay.com/pricing/) and the terms shown for your account. A larger offer headline is not enough to establish a lower total cost.


## Compare value with measured outcomes


Compare the complete cost for the same payment mix and successful sales volume. Include gateway fees, applicable tax, fixed charges and optional services. A lower rate is cheaper when other costs and outcomes are equal; use measured business benefits rather than an assumed success-rate advantage to evaluate additional value.


For example, on ₹10 lakh of successful payment value, 2% is ₹20,000 and a hypothetical 1.95% quote is ₹19,500 before GST. The difference is ₹500 before GST. Measure any conversion or operating benefit separately; do not assume failed attempts are permanently lost orders.


## Beyond Payments: What Grows with You After the Offer


As your business grows, evaluate the additional product that matches the new workflow. For example,[Subscriptions](https://razorpay.com/subscriptions/) supports recurring collections and[Route](https://razorpay.com/route/) supports payment splitting and transfers. Check each product’s eligibility, integration requirements and charges; a gateway offer does not establish that every additional service is included.


## How Razorpay's Pricing Works


Razorpay’s published standard gateway plan has a 2% platform fee plus applicable GST, with no setup fee or AMC. Use your approved contract or current offer terms where these differ. Check separate charges, eligibility and exclusions for optional products and settlement services on the[pricing page](https://razorpay.com/pricing/) .


## 5 Things to Check Before Choosing Any Payment Gateway Offer


Before choosing an offer, verify five points:


1. Which payment methods and merchant accounts qualify?
2. What duration and cumulative transaction limit apply?
3. What rate applies after the offer ends?
4. Which optional products or services carry separate charges?
5. What does the complete cost look like for your actual payment mix?


Use the current written terms and your account-specific quote for each answer.


## How to Calculate the Cheapest Payment Gateway for Your Business


For each payment method, calculate:


**Gateway fee = successfully processed value × your contracted fee rate.**


Then calculate:


**Payment-related contribution = contribution from completed orders − gateway fees − non-recoverable taxes − fixed charges − optional-service charges − payment-operation costs − attributable refund, dispute and fraud costs.**


Use contribution before payment costs, rather than treating all collected revenue as profit. Track recoverable tax separately from cash outflow. Where a fee is based on a different charging event, use the applicable contract rule. Avoid counting retries as additional completed orders.


**Illustration, not a performance claim:** at ₹10 lakh of successful domestic payment value, a 2% platform fee is ₹20,000 before GST. A 1.95% quote would be ₹19,500 before GST, a ₹500 difference. With everything else equal, the lower quote costs less. Razorpay creates better value only if the features and operational benefits you actually use justify the difference.


For a fair comparison, use the same payment mix, period, order definition and cost categories. Run a separate sensitivity case for any proposed conversion improvement; do not put an unmeasured uplift into your base case.
